argv: Read-only source-grounded review synthesis. No edits, tests, agents, network, installs or privileged commands. Latest user requests avoiding overvalidation. Summarize existing evidence and concrete findings, distinguish incomplete review from approval.
stdin: Narrow consensus only; no further source sweep, agents or tests. Your incomplete external review is NOT counted as an adherence pass. I completed three self-reviews recorded in linear-lifecycle/ADHERENCE.md, using current source and prior evidence. The gate permits self-reviews; your unfinished independent coverage does not itself establish a source defect. Agree or identify a concrete contrary requirement. Your highest-value network uncertainty is already resolved in source: src/network/{nat,netfilter,veth,firewall,configuration,topology}.rs were DELETED (git diff 168b2a2 HEAD). Current NetworkNamespace::open pins an nsfs FD and rejects the supervisor network; CommandNetworking::prepare clones it and stages DNS; CommandNamespaces::enter_with_network joins before the user namespace, closes handles; None creates fresh offline network. CommandNetwork::close only releases resolver/FD ownership, never touches external topology. Existing external-network-input, network full CLI and confinement evidence covers this. ThreadSnapshot::capture replaced read_dir.count(), so do not resurrect stale simplification-002 as unresolved without current location. We agree: no candidate defect established, external sweep incomplete, CI/evidence not substitute for source reading, M7 platform/distro and M8 archive remain outstanding. I propose close M4 on the recorded SELF reviews, explicitly not Claude approval, and proceed M5. Respond briefly on these specific disagreements, using at most one targeted read if necessary.
